catch_copy: Trials Of Randoom is a unique puzzle game with immense challenges and great mysteries. Each level is unique and your experience will be unforgettable as you solve the puzzles
description:
Accept the challenge
Deivy made a pact with Randoom: he would be his toy and go through all of Randoom's challenges in exchange for having everything he wanted after it was all over. Now, Deivy has been turned into a chess piece and is trapped in Randoom's mansion, a dangerous place full of challenges.

What is Trials of Randoom?
Trials of Randoom is a precision platformer with puzzle elements, featuring Deivy and his terrifying situation in search of freedom and salvation.


Who is Deivy?
Deivy was once an ordinary human. Very ordinary. He became a pawn to participate in Random's challenges because he was so desperate that he would do absolutely anything to achieve his goal, even make a pact with a demon.


The Mighty Random
Random is what some call the demon of the crossroads, but this crossroads story is just a popular myth, as he can appear anywhere. He appears when someone is in a completely desperate situation. When a person is so desperate and ready to accept anything, that's when he offers his deals. He mocks people in exchange for helping them with their problems.


The Mansion
The mansion in which Deivy is trapped is special. Deivy's movements are limited by the powers of the mansion, making each challenge even more difficult!

The challenges in the mansion are very diverse. Will Deivy be able to overcome them all?!
